description: Observed-order sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/godunov_norm_D1_dirichlet_bc driven by problems/godunov_norm_1d_eikonal_dirichlet_mms.esm. Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*godunov(u) + S|g'| with Dirichlet walls gL=0.5, gR=1.5 and exact solution g = sin(2 pi x) + 0.5 + x; the discretization error is the first-order Godunov truncation S*(|g'| - godunov(g)) = O(dx). The mirror-ghost Dirichlet faces reproduce g's antisymmetric smooth extension so the boundary stays first order; both L2 and Linf fall as O(dx) (expected order 1).
